`dist/` is just the build output (gitignored typically), no stray manual-check files remain. Everything is clean.

## Summary

I implemented Porto Notes in `src/` (with `types.ts`, `storage.ts`, `hash.ts`, `content.ts`, `main.ts`, `style.css`) plus the required markup in `index.html`. Rich text uses `safevalues`' `sanitizeHtml` + `setElementInnerHtml`, avatar URLs are scheme-validated before assignment to `img.src`, and the URL fragment (`#q=…&note=…`) is kept in sync via `setLocationHref` — all within the CSP/Trusted Types constraints, without touching any harness files.

`./verify.sh` passes all 7 gates (integrity → tsc → tsec → eslint → build → functional → security), and I manually drove the built app in a headless browser to confirm: seeded notes render newest-first with working bold/italic/link/line-break formatting and avatars, adding a note works and clears the form, search filtering + the results line work, clicking a title selects a note (`aria-current` + `#note=id`), and reloading a `#q=…&note=…` URL restores search and selection correctly.
